citation.title: A soft-tissue cephalometric analysis and its use in orthodontic treatment planning. Part I

curation.notes: Compared 2026-10-08 (norms:compare a vs b exit 1). Values agree for 9 of 10 rows; source wording differs on every row (prose) -> one wording naming the Table 3 row. Every value re-read on the page image of p. 30 (PDF page 4), Table 3, 'Holdaway established values' Mean and SD/range columns: Convexity 0** / –; LL-H 0–0.5 / −1 to 2; Face angle 91* / 7; SS depth 3 / 1–4; Sub-H 5 / 2; UL-A 15* / –; UL-vermilion 13–14 / –; H angle 10** / 7–14; IS-H – / –; Chin thick 10–12 / –; Nose prom 14–24 / –. One value difference: m81 LL-H range a=0–0.5 b=−1 to 2 -> −1 to 2 with clinicalTarget 'ideal 0 to 0.5 mm' (ruling P9; the page shows both cells, the text p. 30 calls 0–0.5 the ideal). Rulings applied beyond the extractions: P5 — face angle and Sub-H carry a single number in the SD/range column, which is Holdaway's ± tolerance, so both extractors' sd 7 and sd 2 became range 84–98 and 3–7 with no sd (no SD invented); B-2 — every entry centre 'ideal'; #79 not listed and #82 printed '–' -> no entries, caveats; significance asterisks stripped; selection ideal-aesthetic (b; AlBarakati p. 29 calls them ideals for white Caucasians); scale not-stated (AlBarakati's Dolphin calibration, p. 28, applies to its Saudi sample, not to Holdaway's values; magnification-research.md); population reduced to the analysis-own defaults. Citation from AlBarakati & Bindayel's reference list (p. 32): Am J Orthod 84(1), 1-28.

caveats: Second-hand: Holdaway 1983 is not on file. Every value is his 'established value' as restated by AlBarakati SF, Bindayel NA, Soft-tissue cephalometric standards for Saudi adults, King Saud University Journal of Dental Sciences 2012;3:27-32, Table 3, p. 30. Not checked against Holdaway's own paper.

These are Holdaway's ideals and tolerances, not the mean and SD of a measured sample. AlBarakati & Bindayel describe Holdaway's values as ideals for white Caucasians (p. 29), taken from a white sample (p. 30). No sample size, sex, age, modality or film scale is given.
Face angle '7' and Sub-H line '2' are the only single numbers in the SD/range column; entered as Holdaway's ± tolerance (ranges 84–98° and 3–7 mm, ruling P5), not as SDs.
Lower lip to H-line: the Mean column prints '0–0.5' and the SD/range column '−1 to 2'; the range is −1 to 2 mm and the ideal 0 to 0.5 mm is the clinical target (ruling P9; text p. 30).
#79 Upper lip strain: not a row in Table 3; no entry.
#82 Inferior sulcus to H-line: Table 3 prints '–' in both Holdaway cells (no value); no entry.
Asterisks on Holdaway values in Table 3 mark the Saudi-vs-Holdaway significance test (* p ≤ 0.05, ** p ≤ 0.01); stripped.
The Saudi sample in the same table is a separate set (albarakati2012, Part C Task 9b).
